context: Two cafe friends gossip about a karaoke night and message drama
purpose: Teach: いまさら/それどころか/またもや/しゃべる/親しみ/スルー/巻い/歌声

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日のカラオケ、すごい盛り上がったよね。タカシくんの歌声、心に染みた。
lines.en: Yesterday's karaoke was so much fun. Takashi's singing really got to me.
lines.style: Soft dreamy reminiscing, leaning forward with a quiet smile.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当に。あの人、普段シャイなのに、歌うとあんなにしゃべるみたいに表情豊かなんだね。
lines.en: Right? He's usually shy, but when he sings he's expressive as if he's talking.
lines.style: Warm barista observation, slightly impressed and curious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そうそう、いつもよりずっと親しみやすく感じた。マフラー巻いたままシャウトしてたとこ、最高だったわ。
lines.en: Yeah, he felt way more approachable than usual. The shouting with his scarf still wrapped on, the best.
lines.style: Giggling memory, hands acting it out playfully.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: でもね、その後のLINE、私またもやスルーしちゃったの。我ながら情けない。
lines.en: But after that, I once again left his LINE message unread. I'm hopeless.
lines.style: Sheepish confession, voice dropping into self-reproach.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それはまずいよ。いまさら長文で謝るのも変だけど、一言だけでも送ってあげなよ。
lines.en: That's bad. Apologizing with a long message now would be weird, but at least send him one line.
lines.style: Gentle but firm friend-advice, leaning in earnest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それどころか、もう三日も既読つけてないんだ。怖くて開けない。
lines.en: Worse than that — I haven't even marked it read for three days. Too scared to open.
lines.style: Whisper-low admission, eyes on the latte cup.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わたしが横にいるから、深呼吸して開いてみよ。あの歌声を信じて、ちゃんと返事してあげなよ。
lines.en: I'm right here, so take a breath and open it. Trust that singing voice and reply properly.
lines.style: Encouraging, hand on her arm with quiet steadiness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん…ありがと。よし、今ここで返事打つ。
lines.en: Yeah… thanks. Okay, I'll reply right here, right now.
lines.style: Determined small voice, finally lifting her phone.
